To Determine EEPA—Energy Expended for Physical Activity
Can use:
Calories expended in a day using: http://www.cdc.gov/nccdphp/dnpa/
physical/pdf/PA_Intensity_table_2_1.pdf
Or
Can use:
Specific caloric expenditures for different weights using:
http://www.nutribase.com/exercala.htm.
Or
Can multiply REE by the activity factor using:
1.200 5 sedentary (little or no exercise)
1.375 5 lightly active (about 30 minutes of moderate training, 1 to 
3 days/week)
1.550 5 moderately active (45 minutes of moderate training, 3 to 5 days/
week)
1.725 5 very active (training for 1 hour, 6 to 7 days/week)
1.900 5 extra active (very hard training, including weight lifting, 2-3 days/
week)
To continue the example:
The EEPA for this 175-pound athlete who is training hard would be the 
following:
REE (2075 kcalories) x activity factor (1.9) 5 3942 total kcalories for 
BEE and EEPA
To continue the example:
Thermic effect of food (TEF) 5 the total kcalories for REE and EEPA x 
10% 5 3942 x0.1 5 394 kcalories
Total daily energy requirements 5 total kcalories (3942)1 TEF (394 
kcalories) 5 4336 kcalories.
Total daily energy requirements 5 4336 kcalories
